summary: Comprehensive TDD-driven suite with strong unit and integration coverage. Tests all core requirements: glob patterns (**,*,?,basename), label resolution with priorities, deduplication, exclusive rules (StopOnMatch), JSON config loading, changed-files manifests, output formatting, and workflow structure. Good error scenarios (missing files, malformed JSON, invalid rules). Well-organized across three test files (PrLabelAssigner.Tests.ps1, Workflow.Tests.ps1, Run-ActHarness.ps1) with ~45-50 test cases total. Excellent end-to-end testing through real GitHub Actions execution via `act`, validating exact output markers and job success. Main limitations: missing edge cases (complex multi-wildcard patterns, Unicode/special characters in paths/labels, very large datasets, whitespace edge cases); Run-ActHarness script is complex and could benefit from helper functions; fixture file format (fixtures/cases/*.txt) lacks explicit documentation. Would reliably catch regressions in core functionality and typical usage patterns.
